pedagogical_depth.justification: Every lesson includes a full expanded_walkthrough naming a specific Kindergarten trap (over-everything generalisation, lane-by-lane reading absent, no-target compose pile, free-draw without shapes), with teacher_script, common_misconceptions, and recovery_moves. The summative rubric covers all 6 capstone expectations on Ontario's 4-level scale. Materials thoughtfully scaffold pair work and provide differentiation for emerging/extending/ELL/movement learners.

instructional_balance.justification: Each lesson follows the Ontario minds_on / action / consolidation arc with explicit duration_minutes (12 + 25 + 13 = 50 min). Action structure 'whole_group_then_centres' (and 'individual' for capstone) gives floor-vs-desk balance. Pair work is scaffolded with three rotating stations of 7 min each. Differentiation tiers are explicit per lesson.

clarity_communication.justification: Voice is consistent across lessons: Sammy + Mira anchor every minds-on; vocabulary introduced/reinforced is named explicitly; success_criteria use child-friendly 'I can' phrasing; teacher_script is concrete with quoted dialogue. Worksheets use child-voice instructions; manipulatives have step-by-step prep notes.

alignment.justification: Curriculum codes (A9.1-A9.7) are mapped lesson-by-lesson via expectation_lesson_map. Each lesson's primary_expectations align to the blueprint codes. The summative rubric covers all 6 capstone expectations with descriptors that match blueprint.curriculum_expectations text. Image-text alignment validation passes (0 issues): every image_placeholder has keywords + text_image_alignment_check populated.

appearance.justification: Composite generation passes 0 placeholders thanks to the smart_fallback composer (added 2026-05-04). All character images use the existing CHAR_SAMMY_FRONT and CHAR_MIRA_FRONT pipeline. All worksheet/manipulative images have well-described visual_layout and placement specs. Pre-grade drift check: 0 consistency issues, 0 curriculum issues, 0 image-text issues, 0 placeholders.
